beats.speech: Stop saying very quiet. Here are four better words.
Silent: no sound at all. A silent classroom.
Hushed: quiet on purpose. In a hushed voice.
Soft-spoken: with a gentle voice. A soft-spoken teacher.
Tranquil: calm and still. A tranquil lake.
Which word will you use? Comment your own word for very quiet!
